review: An unforgettable masterpiece with breathtaking cinematography and a moving score.
Two hours of my life I will never get back.
The first half is slow, but the last thirty minutes are absolutely thrilling.
I wanted to love it, but the characters were flat and the dialogue was painful.
Not the worst film I've seen this year, but definitely not good either.
The kids loved it and honestly so did I.
Wow, what a great idea to spend 200 million dollars on explosions and forget the story.
Terrifying, disturbing and full of blood: exactly what a horror fan wants.
The acting was wooden and the plot predictable, but I couldn't stop smiling. A guilty pleasure.
Meryl Streep carries the whole film; without her it would be unwatchable.
